scientific_integrity: Proof written from elementary geometric identities and standard billiard optical linearization; source orbit counts and axial traces explicitly credited. Symbolic checker is a corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Period-two linear monodromy of a specified smooth convex eye billiard only; no nonlinear stability, global chaos, or exclusion of other rational-angle resonances. Exact parameter boundaries omitted from open-interval classification; historical uniqueness remains provisional.
title: Two elliptic diagonals and two exact minus-one resonances in the eye-shaped billiard
